insights.title: Changeover is the biggest loss
insights.text: 72.77 h of 480 planned hours (15%) go to emptying the bays and loading dough between orders - more than every fault and failure together (2.43 h). Automating the load/unload is worth more than any other fix.

insights.title: Vacuum losses led the cup's health index
insights.text: VGR-V01 reached 3 in 24 h at hour 518, 62 h before the cup's U6 warning at hour 581 (30 losses by then). The fault rate is an earlier signal than the build-up time: counting VGR-V01 per shift is the next health signal to add.

insights.title: Hall temperature and the air system
insights.text: Raw, air duty barely follows the hall temperature (r = 0.03): the leak's growth over the month dominates. Detrended against its own moving average: r = 0.23; the effect is small next to the leak itself.

insights.title: Shifts compared
insights.text: Early shift 1095 orders, late shift 1088. Maintenance never stopped the line: every work order fitted the night gap (22:00-06:00).

insights.title: The arm is the bottleneck all month
insights.text: It ran 168 h of 397.8 h of production; the oven door ran 78 h. More oven capacity would not raise output; a faster VGR tour would.

insights.title: What the two saves were worth
insights.text: +29 orders, +263 cookies, 10.3 h of unplanned stop avoided, OEE 79.3% -> 80.3%, for 210 min of night-shift work.
